ONE FLOWER A DAY
• Steps are counted quietly on your device, using Apple's motion sensor

• Meet a flower you already have, and its star points multiply instead
• Tomorrow brings a fresh reveal — every day is a new chance at something rare

A NEW SEASON EVERY WEEK
• Each week brings a fresh collection of ten flowers — every one of them for everyone
